body:
I used many substances (shrooms , LSA, Datura, and many more) but I've never encountered anything like this stuff.
One day I was bored out of my mind, the weather sucked and their was nothing to do. It was Saturday anyway and I didn't feel like going out to a bar or anything like that.
I already had some psychological things I wanted to change so I gone to a retailer to get some LSA extract. Unfortunately he had no more LSA to sell - he had shrooms but I already had done shrooms many times ( like 40 times ). I just looked for something to take the edge off and relax.
So he puts his hand under the counter he looked like he was grabbing a shotgun in all seriousness - and comes up with some stuff that should be like ''MDMA''. It was mephodrone in little caps, I trust this retailer because he never sold me any crap - he always sold me clean products, so I bought the cap and gone home.
First thing I did was eating some healthy foods , take vitamins and drink the niagra falls dry because I knew it would suck me dry just like ''E''. I didn't knew how strong this stuff would be so I took it with food so it builds up slowly.  I was getting the atmosphere started, burning inscense, etheric oils etc. I swallowed the capsule with some water and waited for something to happen.
1 hour later I started to feel something, slight euphoria but nothing spectecular. 25 minutes later I was feeling it, to be honest it did feel very good but not what I expected it to be, it, it was way better.  Also gave me slight nausea so I decided to smoke a bowl of cannabis.
When I hit the bowl I was blasted into heaven instantly...I felt orgasmic electrical currents running to my brain - I probably looked like I entered K-hole or something - I cannot describe the extreme euphoria. If I close my eyes I would lose complete focus and descend into my inner world. Completely oblivious. I had trouble staying awake even tho it's a stimulant, so I decided to take some nicotine.
I realized that combining mephedrone with cannabis and nicotine was a horrible idea - even tho my trip became twice as strong the nausea became almost unbearable unless I lay down on the ground. I walked to my bed and tried to relax, then I started hallucinating. Thoughts I would have weren't bad at all, they were like MDMA and LSA - thinking about emotional connections , people I like, how I should open myself on a emotional level. I cannot describe the peak  what I felt, saw and thought - it was vibrating with the universe of empathy, euphoria, compassion and joy.
The peak or ''real effects '' were about 2 hours long. The comedown was pretty long and not enjoyable , headaches, slight muscle cramping, shivers. Next morning I was still high as fuck probably due to the combo I took - however now it was accompanied by slight mental confusion , light periods of panic attacks and headache episodes. Underneath that I felt emotionally connected to everything. And for some reason my eyesight improved I could see better than before, I felt great overall.
I craved for this stuff. Even more than opiates. I realized I was addicted with one cap even tho I don't have an addictive personality. 3 days later I went for another capsule.
Same timeframe however this time it was less enjoyable probably due to the temporary serotonin and dopamine depletion. The nausea was worse than before and I didn't really like the trip at all - at that moment, and thought how stupid I was to take a drug while having tolerance and neurotransmitter depletion. I spend most of this trip in bed trying to sleep it off but it didn't work.
Now I really got a bad trip physically , the vasoconstriction was awful and the headaches were unbearable and persisted for 3 days. These aren't normal headaches they are like anti-depressant brain zaps but without the zaps. Like zeus his lightning got depleted so he stomps your brain instead of throwing lightning bolts. The all day persistent confusion I got was like watching salad fingers episodes while being stoned.
The tachycardia was inconsistent but it took 2 days for it to be gone, accompanied by the tachycardia is difficulty breathing, almost to the point where breathing becomes difficult.
Now about the safety and proper use of this stuff...
1.drink ALOT before doing this drug and when you are tripping your ass off. This stuff cause vasconstriction and dehydration like nothing else.
2. Don't eat proteine before tripping especially tryptophan if you are going to high dosages of MCC. Not only because  you need alot of water to metabolize protein( dehydration ) but also because you are at a serious serotonin syndrom risk if you take tryptophan or 5-HTP.
3. Don't combine it with other substances.. For some reason it makes you more prone to headaches.
4. If you get SEVERE vasoconstriction use 100 mg of grounded niacin.. Double it or triple it if you need to. Second time I got severe vasoconstriction that totally sucked, likely happened because I smoked cannabis when tripping on MMC. My finger tips and lips were starting to go blue - not really bad but still disturbing and certainly unhealthy. I took 300 mg of grounded niacin which relieved a large part of the vasoconstriction.
5. Don't overdo it.. I think 300 mg is way too much for people that weight around 70 kilograms. I think 125 or 150 is a way better dosages for sex , jerking off , dancing, reading or whatever you wan to do. I've done 300 mg twice and both time I was unable to enjoy porn or reading books...300 mg zapped me to another world which was euphoric as fuck but not really what I planned. I planned listening to music and reading books about buddhism, nothing of that really happened because the dosage was too high to do anything else but laying flat in bed.
6. Taking caffeine before or with this stuff increased dehydration, headaches and anxiety... Don't do it.
7. Use 5-HTP or eat alot of tryptophan when your sober , also take vitamins and eat alot of healthy whole foods. You need to replenish your neurotransmitters - not taking care of your health after using such chemical could lead to depression. Pumpkin seeds are a excellent source of tryptophan.
8. Again... Keep drinking drinking and drinking .. If you use the proper dose or slight more than that you sometimes will feel like you are going to throw up but believe me it won't happen.. You can drink shitloads of water while tripping. Most people often don't drink because they think they will throw up after drinking water , actaully drinking water will make you feel better.
9. Keep something to puke in next to your bed and keep a few bottles of water in reach as well..in case you have nausea you still have some water source in reach. Not drinking at all = migraine next day... Be warned.
10. Dehydration = migraine.. Alcohol is increased dehydration.. No matter what other reports say alcohol increases headaches. Cannabis increases vasocontriction, nicotine and cannabis together blow you into heaven but you will suffer the negative after effects for a few days ( not worth it.. Believe me )
The PROS are quitte evident.. This stuff is just like MDMA but a bit lighter. I felt great after doing it for the first time, and that feeling remained for many days. I was emotionally connected to people open and authentic, I got rid of some habits. Overall this is a very nice drug, I think it's way better than most drugs, not just the physical sensations but also the psychological sensations.
11. Do not use this stuff if you had or have a addiction with other substances... Don't underestimate the addictive properties of MMC and 4-MEC..lab experiments in rats shown that these substances create a 800 or 900 % increase in dopamine and serotonin, they think it's even more in human.
CONS when tripping
Almost none.. Slight side effects like other stimulants however the vasoconstriction( constriction of veins)  is pretty bad... Sometimes I felt like I was being fucked in the ass by a boa constrictor.
Other side effects was having no control, coordination conciousness to perform tasks. But that's probably my fault because I probably took too much.
CONS when coming down + a few days ( 2 or 3 days)  after usage
Headaches
Tachycardia
Difficulty breathing
Chemical panic attacks.. Yes.. Not accompanied by thought
Confusion
Light sensitivity
Vertigo
Basically all the side effects you get from taking too much harmfull anti-depressants or other bizarre chemical garbage. It feels like a light case of serotonin syndrom.
Now.. This stuff is addicting as hell, I've been on opiates and I've had benzos and other substances. But this stuff it on a par with the most serious opiate type of drugs regarding it's addictiveness. The only reason im not using MMC alot is because
It creates temporary depletion of serotonin and dopamine, even if you have no tolerance using it again doesn't have it's full blown effects. Just take it from me, it's spiritual benefits dissapear if you do it too much and too often...
1.first time I had a afterglow which persisted for days
2.second time I felt awfull for days
If you use it once just keep it at that and walk away.. Just wait a week or maybe longer and use it again. Second time was not that great and the comedown was terrible. I felt like I got dragged under water by a group of dolpins which took me to a cave and gangraped me untill I lost conciousness - waking up next day on the shore with a huge headache.
I OD on stimulants once and it was total hell, worst blown out experience of my life. If I would had a gun at that time I would blow out my brains to end the misery... If stimulant OD is a 10 on the dolphin rape cave scale then a bad trip on MMC and it's aftereffects  is something like 4... Sounds like it's not bad but it is.
Something else that is pretty weird is 2 small blisters on my lips that come from using MMC ( probably a chemical burn ) , my lips looked dehydrated and sore. Don't use this stuff if you plan on having a date this week.
To summarize it, this is a great drug with great potential, even medicinal potential but it's not something to abuse, not something to do daily or something to use in cocktails. Less is really more. If you want a gradual build up then eat a meal along with a cap. If you want effects quicker just dissolve the powder in the water and swallow.
Stay safe , be carefull , don't abuse this substance and above all - have fun and enjoy the experience. If you start developing addiction just do not buy the drug again - just avoid it. Something that this drug learned me is that addiction has a bigger prices than you can think off... Try to stay in positive vibrations and maintain a healthy life.
If you are being a jackass and abusing this stuff you are a likely candidate for the dolphin rape cave.
Peace
